(chairman & managing director){{Cite web|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rywAyBKRNt0|title = BQ Conversations with Vikram Solar's MD Gyanesh Chaudhary|website = [[YouTube]]| date=20 July 2021 }} | industry = [[Solar energy]] | products = [[Solar panel|Solar module]]s | production = | production_year = | revenue = INR 25,109.90 Million | revenue_year = FY 2023-24 | operating_income = | income_year = | net_income = | net_income_year = | assets = | assets_year = | equity = | equity_year = | owner = | num_members = | num_members_year = | num_employees = 1,513 employees and 728 contractual employees | num_employees_year = FY 2023-24 | parent = | divisions = | subsidiaries = | module = | website = {{URL|http://www.vikramsolar.com}} | footnotes = | former_name = }} '''Vikram Solar Limited''' is an Indian [[solar energy]] company headquartered in [[Kolkata|Kolkata, West Bengal]].{{Cite web |date=24 November 2014 |title=Top 15 solar players in India |url=https://electronicsb2b.com/industry-sections/market-report/top-15-solar-players-india/ |website=[[Electronics For You]]}}{{Cite web |last=Prasad |first=Gireesh Chandra |date=2016-06-15 |title=Vikram Solar to sell shares for expansion |url=https://www.livemint.com/Industry/IThlIcbXsReHNQL8jyDjPL/Vikram-Solar-to-sell-shares-for-expansion.html |access-date=2026-01-22 |website=mint |language=en}} It manufactures [[solar photovoltaic]] (PV) modules and develops solar power projects through [[engineering, procurement, and construction]] (EPC) and [[Maintenance|operations and maintenance]] (O&M) services.{{cite news |last=Shukla |first=Parth |date=21 January 2026 |title=Higher Module Sales Drive Vikram Solar's Revenue Up 50% YoY in 9M FY 2026 |url=https://www.mercomindia.com/higher-module-sales-drive-vikram-solars-revenue-up-50-yoy-in-9m-fy2026 |access-date=22 January 2026 |work=Mercom India}} As of January 2026, the company has an annual module manufacturing capacity of 9.5 [[Watt#Gigawatt|GW]]. Vikram Solar became a [[Public company|publicly traded company]] in August 2025 and is listed on the [[Bombay Stock Exchange]] (BSE) and the [[National Stock Exchange of India]] (NSE). == History == Vikram Solar was founded in 2005 by Gyanesh Chaudhary.{{Cite web |last=Dinakar |first=S |date=26 December 2025 |title=Evaluating setting up shop in United States: Vikram Solar chairman |url=https://www.business-standard.com/companies/people/evaluating-setting-up-shop-in-united-states-vikram-solar-chairman-125122500609_1.html |access-date=2026-01-22 |website=Business Standard}} It began manufacturing operations in 2009 with an initial annual capacity of 12 MW.{{Cite web |title=Vikram Solar's moment under the green energy sun |url=https://www.forbesindia.com/article/leadership/vikram-solars-moment-under-the-green-energy-sun/94703/1 |access-date=2026-01-22 |website=www.forbesindia.com |language=en}} In its early operations, the company participated in [[Photovoltaic power station|utility-scale solar]] projects in India and Germany, including projects under the first phase of India's [[National Solar Mission]].{{Cite news |last=Thakkar |first=Mitul |date=2013-12-24 |title=Vikram Solar supplies solar power equipments to Germany |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/indl-goods/svs/engineering/vikram-solar-supplies-solar-power-equipments-to-germany/articleshow/27843305.cms?from=mdr |access-date=2026-01-22 |work=The Economic Times |issn=0013-0389}} Between 2013 and 2014, the company installed a 100 kW rooftop solar facility at [[Cochin International Airport]] and commissioned a 10 kW floating solar plant in Rajarhat, Kolkata, which was the first such installation in India.{{cite news |last=Pearson |first=Natalie Obiko |date=12 August 2014 |title=Vikram Solar to Build India's First Floating Solar Plant |url=https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2014-08-12/vikram-solar-to-build-india-s-first-floating-solar-plant |work=[[Bloomberg News]]}} From 2015 to 2019, the company increased its annual manufacturing capacity to 1 GW and began exporting modules to Africa, Europe, and the United States. During this period, it executed utility-scale projects for several public-sector entities, including [[NTPC Limited]]. In August 2025, the company completed an initial public offering (IPO) that raised ₹2,079 crore. Its equity shares were listed on the BSE and NSE on 26 August 2025.{{Cite news |last=Kumar |first=Sachin |date=2025-08-19 |title=Can Vikram Solar justify its high valuations with rapid growth? |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/ipos/fpos/can-vikram-solar-justify-its-high-valuations-with-rapid-growth/articleshow/123374467.cms?from=mdr |access-date=2026-01-22 |work=The Economic Times |issn=0013-0389}}{{Cite news |last=Podishetti |first=Akash |date=2025-08-26 |title=Vikram Solar makes a muted D-St debut, shares list at 2% premium over IPO price |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/news/vikram-solar-makes-a-muted-d-st-debut-shares-list-at-2-premium-over-ipo-price/articleshow/123516634.cms?from=mdr |access-date=2026-01-22 |work=The Economic Times |issn=0013-0389}} == Manufacturing and technology == Vikram Solar's manufacturing facilities are located at the [[Falta, South 24 Parganas|Falta Special Economic Zone]] in [[West Bengal]], and in [[Oragadam]] and [[Vallam]] in [[Tamil Nadu]]. In November 2025, the company commissioned an automated facility in Vallam with an annual capacity of 5 GW, increasing its total installed module manufacturing capacity to 9.5 GW.{{Cite web |last=Dasgupta |first=Mithun |date=2025-11-26 |title=Vikram Solar commissions 5 GW of module manufacturing facility at Tamil Nadu’s Vallam |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/vikram-solar-commissions-5-gw-of-module-manufacturing-facility-at-tamil-nadus-vallam-plans-to-commission-another-6-gw-capacity-at-gangaikondan-facility-in-fourth-quarter/article70326817.ece |access-date=2026-01-22 |website=BusinessLine |language=en}} The Vallam facility utilizes tunnel oxide passivated contact (TOPCon) cell technology and is configured to manufacture modules in M10, G12, and G12R wafer formats.{{Cite web |date=2025-11-26 |title=Vikram Solar commissions new 5 GW Vallam plant in Tamil Nadu |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/vikram-solar-announces-commissioning-of-5-gw-module-manufacturing-facility-in-tamil-nadus-vallam/article70324719.ece |access-date=2026-01-22 |website=BusinessLine |language=en}} In January 2026, Vikram Solar reported that it had transitioned its module portfolio to G12R-based configurations.{{cite news |date=16 January 2026 |title=Vikram Solar to transition all module production to G12R format |url=https://www.pv-tech.org/vikram-solar-to-transition-all-module-production-to-g12r-format/ |access-date=22 January 2026 |work=PV Tech}} extract:
Vikram Solar Limited is an Indian solar energy company headquartered in Kolkata, West Bengal. It manufactures solar photovoltaic (PV) modules and develops solar power projects through engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) and operations and maintenance (O&M) services.
As of January 2026, the company has an annual module manufacturing capacity of 9.5 GW. Vikram Solar became a publicly traded company in August 2025 and is listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) and the National Stock Exchange of India (NSE).
